text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Good grief, who's calling for me?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Just as a masterstroke of a plan was about 
to come together, too—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...... Could it be... that the Three 
Goddesses were the ones calling me?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Interesting. If that's the case, I suppose 
I'll hear what you have to say—
